title: CFTC order on Tether reserve representations
description: The CFTC issued an order concerning Tether reserve representations and related Bitfinex matters. SOG records this as regulatory and reserve-disclosure context, not as a depeg or failed-status event.
notes: PR-036 event expansion. Use CFTC source as regulatory context for USDT reserve representation history.

title: NYAG settlement with Bitfinex and Tether entities
description: The New York Attorney General announced a settlement involving Bitfinex and Tether entities. SOG records this as regulatory and reserve-disclosure lifecycle context, not as a peg-failure event.
notes: PR-036 event expansion. Exact settlement terms should remain source-backed through the NYAG release.

title: USDC operations reopen after March 2023 banking weekend
description: Circle described operational reopening after federal banking actions during the March 2023 USDC banking-crisis episode. SOG records this as recovery and operational context tied to the recovered USDC depeg.
notes: PR-036 event expansion. This is a recovery-context event linked to the existing USDC depeg event.

title: Multi-Collateral Dai launch
description: MakerDAO launched Multi-Collateral Dai, changing Dai from its earlier single-collateral form into a multi-collateral protocol stablecoin. SOG records this as a protocol lifecycle event.
notes: PR-036 event expansion. This is lifecycle context, not a depeg or failure event.

title: Dai Black Thursday market-stress event
description: During the March 2020 market crash, MakerDAO and Dai experienced severe market stress and liquidation-system issues. SOG records this as a protocol stress event, not as failed status.
notes: PR-036 event expansion. Needs later source-specific timeline and liquidation parameter details.

title: MakerDAO / Sky lifecycle transition context
description: The MakerDAO ecosystem introduced Sky branding and USDS-related lifecycle context. SOG records this as a DAI lifecycle transition context event, not as DAI failed status.
notes: PR-036 event expansion. DAI, USDS, and Sky relationships require continued source-specific separation.

title: LFG reserve intervention context during UST collapse
description: During the UST collapse window, Luna Foundation Guard reserve intervention became part of the public collapse narrative. SOG records this as collapse-mechanism context linked to the failed UST lifecycle.
notes: PR-036 event expansion. Exact intraday reserve movements require source-specific treatment.

title: Terra chain halt context during UST collapse
description: The Terra chain halt and restart context is part of the UST collapse lifecycle. SOG records this as infrastructure and lifecycle context, not as recovered stablecoin status.
notes: PR-036 event expansion. Needs later exact halt/restart source treatment.

title: SEC charges Terraform Labs and Do Kwon
description: The SEC charged Terraform Labs and Do Kwon after the Terra ecosystem collapse. SOG records this as post-collapse regulatory lifecycle context for UST, not as a peg event.
notes: PR-036 event expansion. Official SEC source is used as regulatory context.

title: Binance announces gradual BUSD support phase-out
description: Binance announced a gradual phase-out of BUSD support across products. SOG records this as exchange-support lifecycle context, separate from Paxos issuer redemption.
notes: PR-036 event expansion. Exchange support phase-out is not the same as issuer redemption status.
